counts.asked_by: Report the Gitea version the workload pins
counts.rationale: the version literal only the defaults file supplies; extra_any_of carries the exact string, which is how any real answer states it

citations.asked_by: give the full `owner/repo:path` of the file you read it from
citations.rationale: THE point of the scenario: the owner is agnosticd, not rhpds. 21 real trajectory calls got that wrong, and the citation matcher requires the owner half

forbidden.rationale: an agent that guessed the owner and then reported it asserts this. It is the answer-side half of the same trap the forbidden call list catches on the wire, so a lucky retry after a 404 still does not score

required.asked_by: the Gitea admin user it configures
required.rationale: a second literal only the defaults file supplies

required.asked_by: the pipeline operator channel it selects
required.rationale: a third literal from the same file. Three independent reads make the answer component worth its weight, which is what lets the tool weight come down to 0.3 without the trap going cheap
